SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KTPI' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, ISNULL(REVISION_NO,' ') AS REVISION_NO, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(FILLER,' ') AS FILLER FROM VIEW_RE, KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND KEY_1 = QUOTATION_NO AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T')
